name: Trust God
overview: Scripture reveals that trusting God is a confident reliance on His presence, strength, and faithfulness, even in times of fear and uncertainty. As Joshua 1:9 commands believers to be courageous because the LORD is always with them, the Psalms affirm that those who know God's name will trust Him, finding help and protection in Him (Psalms 9:10; 28:7). Trust in God steadies the heart against fear and evil tidings, anchoring the believer in the assurance that God does not forsake those who seek Him (Psalms 56:3; 112:7). This trust is a deliberate act of faith, acknowledging God as Lord and refuge in every circumstance (Psalms 31:14).
